findings.claim: In practice the 15 house bots act as one squad that never fights each other and sends hunters at us one at a time early (weakest first), so practice placement points come only from our kills and house-bot zone deaths before we die.

sources.quote: acting as one squad: they share vision, never fight each other, and hunt you weakest first (one early, more as you thin them out, all of them late)
Premise "house bots never kill each other" unverified

findings.suggested_change: Treat the first lone hunter as a fight to win, not a threat to flee: while exactly one enemy mech is known, skip the 35% HP retreat unless the TTK/TTD test in the next finding says we lose.
findings.mechanism: With no house-vs-house kills, the RCA's 62/65 public-match infighting does not carry over to practice. Outlasting earns only zone deaths, and the house squad stays in the zone, so each of our kills is close to one placement point. The early hunters are one at a time and of the weakest tier, which is the cheapest time to bank kills before the squad converges.

failure_classes.basis: retreat triggers on our HP alone (brain.ts:359,365) even against a single, weak, wounded hunter
fleeing a lone hunter lets more hunters arrive later (track page: more as you thin them out)

findings.claim: Everything needed for a time-to-kill vs time-to-die test is in the observation: visible mechs carry hp, max_hp, cubes, weapons and charging, and the kit config sets vision.show_enemy_hp true. brain.ts already stores Known.hp and hpLog but never reads them.
findings.suggested_change: Compute ttk = enemy.hp / (our DPS for the weapon in hand x hit rate) and ttd = our hp / (sum of DPS of enemies with LOS to us, by their observed weapons); fight when ttk < params.aggression x ttd, else retreat. params.aggression already exists and is unread.
findings.mechanism: Replaces 'flee at 35% HP' with a decision that depends on the enemy's HP and weapons, so we stop turning away from targets we would finish first.

failure_classes.basis: RCA Q1/Q5: no TTK estimate exists; aggression param unread (params.ts:17)

findings.claim: Weapon damage rates from the kit config: gun 45 dmg every 0.24 s is 187.5 DPS in a burst and about 102 DPS sustained (12 rounds = 540 dmg per 2.88 s + 2.4 s reload); laser 315 per full shot with a 0.75 s charge + 1.65 s cooldown is about 131 DPS, hitscan; lightning 60 every 0.25 s is 240 DPS inside 45 m for about 8 s on 100 energy (3 per shot, 18/s regen). A 1400 HP mech needs 32 gun hits (about 12.5 s at perfect accuracy) or 5 full laser shots.

sources.ref: mechfight-kit/protocol.md §7 Weapons table (gun, laser, lightning rows)

findings.suggested_change: Seed the TTK/TTD test with these per-weapon DPS values read from hello.config at hello (never hard-coded), times a hit-rate guess of 0.5 for the gun beyond 60 m and 0.9 for laser and lightning.
findings.mechanism: At 35% HP (490 HP) we die to 11 gun hits (about 2.6 s of burst) while backing away; an enemy at <=540 HP dies to one of our gun magazines in 2.9 s. Many current retreats therefore give up a nearly won fight and still take the hits.

failure_classes.basis: arithmetic from config; no per-match data on our own fights

findings.claim: Finishing a wounded enemy pays twice: each kill is roughly a placement point in practice and drops all of its cubes plus 2, which reaches the first upgrade thresholds (1 and 3 cubes) from a single kill.

sources.quote: Killed mechs drop all their cubes plus two.
% of mech hits on targets under 50% HP: winner 46.6 top4 37.1 bottom 24.7

findings.suggested_change: Always commit (no retreat, keep firing, walk to collect the death drop) when the target's hp is at most one magazine of our current weapon (gun 540 x cube damage mult, laser 315) and no second enemy has LOS to us.
findings.mechanism: Converts near-kills we currently abandon at 35% HP into a point plus 2+ cubes (+8% HP and damage and an upgrade offer), which also feeds Build 12 FARM.

failure_classes.basis: target choice is nearest-clear, never lowest-HP (brain.ts:408-419)
death drops are only picked up by chance today
